id: \bHello. I used to be a Stats Judge, but my job became obsolete when Trainers became able to see a Pokémon's potential on their own. Now I'm retired...
en: \bHello. I used to be a Stats Judge, but my job became obsolete when Trainers became able to see a Pokémon's potential on their own. Now I'm retired...
it: \bSalve. Un tempo ero un Giudice delle Statistiche, ma il mio lavoro è diventato inutile quando gli Allenatori hanno imparato a vedere da soli il potenziale dei Pokémon. Ora sono in pensione...

id: \bHold on a minute... your future. It's brilliant! Yes, I can just tell!
en: \bHold on a minute... your future. It's brilliant! Yes, I can just tell!
it: \bAspetta un attimo... il tuo futuro. È brillante! Sì, lo sento!

id: \bTrainer... go out there and find some Pokémon!
en: \bTrainer... go out there and find some Pokémon!
it: \bAllenatore... vai là fuori e trova qualche Pokémon!

id: \bI see you achieved that brilliant future.
en: \bI see you achieved that brilliant future.
it: \bVedo che hai raggiunto quel futuro brillante.

id: \bAh ha!
en: \bAh ha!

id: \bWait, I missed it.
en: \bWait, I missed it.

id: \bWe come to the cafe to relax.
en: \bWe come to the cafe to relax.

id: \rIt's amazing what people can dream up. The mints here can change a Pokémon's nature. Whoever figured that out should be proud.
en: \rIt's amazing what people can dream up. The mints here can change a Pokémon's nature. Whoever figured that out should be proud.
it: \rÈ incredibile cosa riescono a inventarsi le persone. Le mente che vendono qui possono cambiare la natura di un Pokémon. Chi l'ha scoperto dovrebbe esserne fiero.

id: \bLet's get to it.
en: \bLet's get to it.

id: \bThis was all very useful. Thank you.
en: \bThis was all very useful. Thank you.

id: \rThe mints you can buy here are categorized by the stat they boost. Attack, Defense, Sp. Attack, Sp. Defense, and Speed to be exact.
en: \rThe mints you can buy here are categorized by the stat they boost. Attack, Defense, Sp. Attack, Sp.  Defense, and Speed to be exact.
it: \rLe mente che puoi comprare qui sono divise in base alla statistica che aumentano. Attacco, Difesa, Attacco Speciale, Difesa Speciale e Velocità, per la precisione.

id: \bAhhhh, tastes so good.
en: \bAhhhh, tastes so good.

id: \bWelcome to our company. Here we manufacture Poké Balls. Feel free to look around.
en: \bWelcome to our company. Here we manufacture Poké Balls. Feel free to look around.
it: \bBenvenuto nella nostra azienda. Qui produciamo Poké Ball. Fai pure un giro.

id: \bI've been running all my life. I'm tired of it all. Take this and take it away from me.
en: \bI've been running all my life. I'm tired of it all. Take this and take it away from me.
it: \bHo corso per tutta la vita. Sono stanco di tutto. Prendi questo e portalo via da me.

id: \bLeave me to my memories.
en: \bLeave me to my memories.

id: \bShould my Tepig have a Brave or Sassy nature? I can't decide.
en: \bShould my Tepig have a Brave or Sassy nature? I can't decide.
it: \bIl mio Tepig dovrebbe avere natura Audace o Vivace? Non riesco a decidermi.

id: \bWelcome to our store.
en: \bWelcome to our store.

id: \rSit for a while, dear.
en: \rSit for a while, dear.

id: \bAre you here to help out?
en: \bAre you here to help out?

id: \bGreat battle. That will help us out.
en: \bGreat battle. That will help us out.
it: \bBella lotta. Ci sarà di grande aiuto.

id: \rWelcome to Studio Castelia.
en: \rWelcome to Studio Castelia.

id: \rI don't have enough money to buy anything. But they sell so many variations here.
en: \rI don't have enough money to buy anything. But they sell so many variations here.
it: \rNon ho abbastanza soldi per comprare niente. Ma qui vendono così tante varianti...

id: \rThe art here is amazing.
en: \rThe art here is amazing.

id: \bYou come into my home and ask for something. That's taunting me.
en: \bYou come into my home and ask for something.  That's taunting me.
it: \bEntri in casa mia e chiedi qualcosa. Mi stai provocando.

id: \bYou shouldn't taunt people.
en: \bYou shouldn't taunt people.

id: \bNone of this work is from Burgh...
en: \bNone of this work is from Burgh...
it: \bNessuna di queste opere è di Artemisio...

id: \bA test subject.
en: \bA test subject.

id: \bI need to write this down.
en: \bI need to write this down.

id: \bFinally, research.
en: \bFinally, research.

id: \bThank you very much.
en: \bThank you very much.

id: \bDon't mess with me. Long day of work.
en: \bDon't mess with me. Long day of work.
it: \bNon farmi arrabbiare. È stata una lunga giornata di lavoro.

id: \bThanks for helping out. Take this as a reward.
en: \bThanks for helping out. Take this as a reward.
it: \bGrazie per l'aiuto. Prendi questo come ricompensa.

id: \bEmployees only.
en: \bEmployees only.

id: It's a painting of a person and Pokémon.
en: It's a painting of a person and Pokémon.
it: È un dipinto che raffigura una persona e un Pokémon.
